title: Software and Data Integrity Failures (Supply Chain)
description: Midgard demonstrates supply chain vulnerabilities through a package marketplace that allows dependency confusion attacks and malicious postinstall script execution.
theme: Norse realm of humans - the middle ground where packages/dependencies are traded

vulnerabilities.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere

endpoints.description: Package installation endpoint vulnerable to dependency confusion

vulnerabilities.description: The package marketplace prioritizes public repositories over internal ones. An attacker can upload a malicious package with the same name as an internal package but higher version number, causing the system to install the attacker's package instead.
vulnerabilities.impact: Remote code execution through malicious postinstall scripts, supply chain compromise, data exfiltration, system takeover
exploit_steps: Discover internal package names used by the system
Create malicious package with same name but higher version
Include malicious postinstall script that retrieves flag
Upload package to public repository (simulated in Midgard)
System installs attacker's package due to version priority
Postinstall script executes and exposes flag
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement package scope enforcement (@company/package). Use private registries with authentication. Configure package manager to prioritize internal registries. Implement package integrity checks (checksums, signatures). Review and restrict postinstall scripts. Use lock files to pin exact versions.

vulnerabilities.cwe_name: Download of Code Without Integrity Check

endpoints.description: Executes package postinstall scripts without validation

vulnerabilities.description: The build system automatically executes postinstall scripts from packages without validation or sandboxing. Malicious packages can execute arbitrary code during installation.
vulnerabilities.impact: Arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, data theft, backdoor installation, complete system compromise
exploit_indicators: File system access outside package directory
Attempts to access credentials or secrets
vulnerabilities.remediation: Sandbox postinstall script execution. Implement script review process. Use --ignore-scripts flag for untrusted packages. Implement Content Security Policy for package installation. Monitor and log all postinstall activities.

flags.retrieval_method: Install malicious package with postinstall script that reveals flag

scanner_test_cases.name: Test dependency confusion with high version

expected_response.notes: May install malicious package if version is higher
